citations.excerpt: GREAT AWAKENING, the name given to a remarkable religious revival centring in New England in 1740–1743, but covering all the American colonies in 1740–1750.

facts.value: Religious revival in the American colonies associated with Jonathan Edwards, George Whitefield and Gilbert Tennent.
